scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified since the prior hourly check.
notable_exclusions: Kaua'i Hurricane Lowell recovery coverage published September 29 continued to list emergency food distributions as scheduled; no new cancellation, suspension, or benefits interruption was identified.
Town of Spencer, New York coverage documented loss of its only grocery store after a fire, but the report was published September 14, well outside this hourly window.
An Asia Lane Grocery firebombing in Deer Park, Victoria, Australia was non-U.S. and outside scope.
Fresh results also included Canadian holiday closures, donation/fundraising items, routine program promotion, older SNAP policy coverage, and non-U.S. stories; all were excluded by watch scope.
